prompt:
Create ONE square memory-card aircraft COLOUR SKETCH. The supplied image is ONLY the approved STYLE AND EXACT SIZE-ON-PAGE reference. Match its finished fine coloured-pencil/graphite strokes, gentle watercolour shading, natural colours, soft upper-left light and warm ivory paper. Create the new subject below, not a Mustang.
LAYOUT: the COMPLETE new aircraft must fit inside an imaginary CENTRED square measuring ONLY 65% of the page width and height. Vast blank ivory paper around it, minimum 17.5% empty margin on ALL four sides, including beyond every rotor blade and wingtip. Keep it SMALL-TO-MEDIUM like the reference, never zoom in. Slightly elevated front three-quarter view, nose lower left, entire aircraft visible. Square 1:1 PNG at least 1024x1024.
Exactly one aircraft, isolated on completely blank ivory paper. NO text, letters, registrations, numbers, airline names, watermark, signature, labels, borders, clouds, ground, landscape, people or unrelated items. No external weapons or tanks. No cast shadow. Accurate coherent airframe, engine count, wings and rotor structure. Retractable gear up; fixed wheels/floats/skids visible. Distinct propeller and rotor blades with no opaque blur discs.
SUBJECT: Boeing CH-47 Chinook, unmistakable large TANDEM-ROTOR transport helicopter, long rounded rectangular sand-tan fuselage, front cockpit windows, small round cabin portholes, raised rear rotor pylon, TWO separate three-bladed main rotor assemblies, one at front and one at rear. Small wheeled landing gear visible; NO tail rotor. Draw coherent, neatly separated front and rear rotor hubs and readable six rotor blades; all rotor extremities inside the safe area.

edits.prompt: Edit this Boeing CH-47 Chinook colour-pencil illustration to correct its scale and remove any writing. Preserve the complete helicopter's exact geometry, rotor blade counts, rotor hubs, cabin, tail, undercarriage, colours, lighting and fine pencil texture. Shrink the ENTIRE helicopter UNIFORMLY to 82% of its current size and centre it on the same square warm ivory sheet. The COMPLETE silhouette INCLUDING every rotor blade and tail extremity must occupy no more than 75% of the page width and height. Leave at least 12.5% entirely blank paper on ALL four sides. Extend the identical ivory paper seamlessly. Remove ALL text, logos, brand names, registration numbers, serials and lettering on the helicopter; replace them with the underlying paint colour. In particular the Bell 47's orange fuel tank must have completely plain orange paint without any black writing. No captions, border, signature, scenery or added objects.
